messages:
Sam: Nightly billing flagged 19 failed card charges. Gateway: 4 do_not_retry, 10 insufficient_funds, 5 issuer_decline. Need plan to minimize churn.

billing-bot: Report attached. Affected invoices: [INV-9123, INV-9128, INV-9135, ...]. At-risk MRR: $26,700.

Ivy: For soft declines (insufficient_funds + issuer_decline) run retry sweep: attempts at t+0, t+6h, t+24h. For do_not_retry mark manual-collect and trigger card-update email.

Diego: Agree. One customer (LumaLabs) is >$10k invoice; propose hold auto-retries and surface wire option first. We have unverified wire details on file for them.

Priya: I'll draft the customer message. Short copy: "We tried to process invoice <INV#> and it failed. We'll retry once automatically. To update payment info, visit <link>. To request wire details reply 'WIRE'." Add note about next action to avoid service impact.

Sam: Ops asks: (1) approval to kick sweep for soft declines now, (2) set manual-collect for do_not_retry, (3) hold auto-retry for high-value invoices until wire confirmed, (4) ensure retries logged to invoice history.

Ivy: Approve with audit logging requirement. Also: if any retry returns `card_not_on_file` or `do_not_retry` on subsequent attempts, stop and mark for manual follow-up.

Diego: For 2 failed ACH setups, switch to micro-deposit verification and pause scheduled debits until verified. Keep original setup metadata in payment notes.

Ivy: Dry-run CLI to validate list: ./billing retry --filter "status:declined AND method:card AND code:soft" --schedule "0h,6h,24h" --dry-run
If dry-run looks good, remove --dry-run to execute.

billing-bot: Actions recorded: retry_sweep_pending(dry-run), manual_collect_flag(4), hold_for_wire(3), ach_microdeposit(2). Ticket FIN-4582 created.

Sam: Dry-run completed: 15 soft declines selected, no gateway rate-limit warnings. Expected success on second attempt ~40%. Proceeding to run live sweep.

Priya: I'll post email template to #customer-ops for AE review. Subject: "Payment attempt failed for your Redwood invoice"

Diego: Confirm marking LumaLabs invoice as pending-wire and ping their AE before any retry.

Sam: Live sweep executed at 1835002188. Audit file uploaded: FIN/collections/sweeps/1835002109.csv. Closing this thread; tracking in FIN-4582.
